# modboss v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

Modbus schema mapping with automatic encoding/decoding.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://modboss.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [ModBoss](https://modboss.hexdocs.pm/ModBoss.md): Human-friendly modbus reading, writing, and translation.
- [ModBoss.Encoding](https://modboss.hexdocs.pm/ModBoss.Encoding.md): Built-in encoding/decoding functions
- [ModBoss.Encoding.Metadata](https://modboss.hexdocs.pm/ModBoss.Encoding.Metadata.md): Metadata to support encoding and decoding.
- [ModBoss.Mapping](https://modboss.hexdocs.pm/ModBoss.Mapping.md): Struct representing a modbus mapping.

- [ModBoss.Schema](https://modboss.hexdocs.pm/ModBoss.Schema.md): Macros for establishing Modbus schema.
- [ModBoss.Telemetry](https://modboss.hexdocs.pm/ModBoss.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events emitted by ModBoss.
